$comment: Bank-approved copy (demo). Conventional templates are seeded as 'approved'; Islamic as 'sharia_approved'. Syntax: {fact}, [[fact: shown when fact is non-zero]], [[!fact: shown when fact is zero]]. Doha Demo Bank is fictional. 'generic' entries carry no customer data and are served when no consent is on record (non-negotiable 5). 'factLabels' label the fact chips; 'explanations' word the 'Why am I seeing this?' reasons. Labels and explanations are shared by both variants, so they use variant-neutral terms.

templates.headline: Before you convert a purchase to instalments
templates.body: Instalment plans spread a purchase over several months and usually have a processing fee. Paying the purchase in full by the due date has no charge. You can see the plan's terms in the app, or ask us, before you continue.

templates.headline: قبل تحويل مشترياتك إلى أقساط
templates.body: خطط التقسيط توزّع قيمة المشتريات على عدة أشهر، وعادةً تترتب عليها رسوم معالجة. سداد المشتريات كاملة قبل تاريخ الاستحقاق لا تترتب عليه رسوم. يمكنك الاطلاع على شروط الخطة في التطبيق أو سؤالنا قبل المتابعة.
